adjustments.author: Claude (AI-proposed)
adjustments.evidence: 10-K FY2025, MD&A [938c25cc7e2ea066]: "net gains on equity securities of $24.1 billion, primarily related to unrealized gains on our non-marketable equity securities"
adjustments.rationale: The FY2025 gain is 15% of pretax income (24,080 / 158,826) and is mostly unrealized fair-value adjustments on non-marketable (private) securities. It explains a large part of FY2025 EPS growth that did not come from operations.

adjustments.author: Claude (AI-proposed)
adjustments.rationale: Server life went from four to six years in 2023. Removing the effect puts FY2023 on the FY2022 basis for trend comparison. The effect continues in FY2024-FY2025 but the filings do not quantify it for those years, so those years are NOT adjusted: treat reported FY2024-FY2025 margins as benefiting from a longer life assumption.
